title: YEEZY BOOST 700
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 700 'Carbon Blue' is a study of tonality inspired by previous 700 models. Debuted in December 2019, the sneaker is presented with a muted blue scheme across the upper's suede and nubuck panels with the tongue and laces in a bright tint. A sculpted midsole housing full-length Boost, with defined pops of color and dual-tone rubber outsole finish it off.

title: YEEZY SLIDE KIDS
description: The adidas Yeezy Slide Kids ‘Ochre’ applies an uneven light brown finish to the fashion-forward sandal, featuring a rubberized foam build with a textured surface. The minimalist design is free of any exterior branding, save for adidas’ three-stripe logo stamped on the soft top layer of the footbed. Open-toe construction delivers ventilated comfort, while an aggressive sawtooth-pattern outsole provides a blend of cushioning and traction for a smooth ride.
